description: Check the exact final release package through normal player paths; repeat focused sessions if needed.
prerequisites: Exact artifact intended for publication; no dev shortcuts
Fresh/disposable installation and copied save fixtures
Human tester with physical audio/controller access

review.expect: Fresh installation and update from the prior release work; copied saves/settings survive. Record both artifacts and installation evidence.
Normal setup/title/Continue loads the copied character and village; no Debug shortcut.
Accept/depart through normal counter/gate; fight, change area, return and inspect rewards. Record quest IDs, weapons and duration.
Save to the disposable fixture, restart the exact artifact, and reload successfully.
World/effects/UI, selected languages, quest fields and camera are correct; review captures.
Music/effects/voice and mute settings work; no recurring crackle, missing music or timing problems.
Physical controller/touch/keyboard used on this platform respond correctly, including menus and reconnect.
Normal game speed remains 100%; record frame-rate/thermal trends during a representative hunt. Repeat bounded sessions for long-play coverage.
Two normal-path offline/online fixtures discover/join, depart, fight, return, disconnect/reconnect; no debug writes. Record both builds/devices and session evidence.
Locally available DLC/event quests load through normal player paths. Missing fixtures remain NOT TESTED.
Platform packaging, suspend/resume, display changes and relevant permissions behave correctly; Deck Game Mode and Android lifecycle require actual device evidence.
